test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hash_join_consecutive_build (k UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO hash_join_consecutive_build SELECT number, number FROM numbers(2000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM ( SELECT intDiv(number, {run_length}) % 2000000 AS k FROM numbers_mt(20000000) ) AS l INNER JOIN hash_join_consecutive_build AS r ON l.k = r.k SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', enable_join_fixed_hash_table_conversion = 0, query_plan_join_swap_table = 0 FORMAT Null
